cards.title: Today’s vocabulary
sections: welcome back · /ˌwɛlkəm ˈbæk/ · fixed expression · Phrase · New
a greeting used when someone returns to a place or group. Welcome back, Puck. Your seat is here.
a very informal greeting, often used with people you know. Hey, Heart! Come and sit with us.
good morning · /ˌɡʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ/ · fixed expression · Phrase · New
a greeting used in the morning. Good morning, everyone. It is nine o'clock.
good afternoon · /ˌɡʊd ˌæftɚˈnun/ · fixed expression · Phrase · New
a greeting used after noon and before the evening. Good afternoon. Our class starts at two.
good evening · /ˌɡʊd ˈivnɪŋ/ · fixed expression · Phrase · New
a greeting used when meeting someone in the evening. Good evening. Welcome to our six o'clock class.

cards.title: I’m /aɪm/
sections: Join I and am into one syllable. Close your lips for the final /m/; do not add another vowel.
Listen. Say it. Record a second attempt after checking one sound.
cards.name: Everyday English - A1 - Day 001 - Pronunciation & Listening - 01

articulation.label: I’m
articulation.alt: I’m: /aɪ/ → /m/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /a/: Start with the tongue low and jaw open.
/ɪ/: Glide up and forward; narrow the jaw gap.
/m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
